nom: Neutrogena Ageless Intensives Deep Wrinkle Anti-Wrinkle Serum

avis.titre: Best Retinol Serum on the Market
avis.texte: I've been using this product since my early 40s. I am now 53 and am told I look like I'm in my 30s. It really is the best retinol serum I've ever used. It IS a retinol product, so it may sting a bit at first as your skin gets used to it. If that happens I recommend using once a week at first and then stepping up of the frequency until you're able to use it on a daily basis. I have very sensitive skin and this process worked for me. Please note that it will take 6 months to see any significant results, this is true of ANY wrinkle serum. It takes about 6 months for complete skin cell turnover no matter the product. I have tried other, more expensive, high-end products and keep coming back to this Deep Wrinkle Serum, it really works!

The package told me this was an "intensive treatment" and I certainly found it to be that! I used it each night for a week and experienced some mild burning and redness. After two days the exfoliation began, particularly under my eyes, and I woke up each morning looking a bit rough; as if recovering from sunburn. It also exposed seemingly new wrinkles under my eyes. A bit dismayed, I decided to continue as directed and after a few more days a new layer of smooth wrinkle free skin materialized! It really took years off my appearance, and I have been complimented by several people in that regard. I have now set aside this product and switched to Neutrogena's Deep Wrinkle Night Moisturizer for daily maintenance. This Serum is a bit too intense for prolonged use in my case, but for periodic correction I would definitely and highly recommend it.

avis.titre: GREAT PRODUCTS THAT DO NOT DISAPPOINT
avis.texte: With fine lines, and deeper wrinkles, at my age, yet being told for the many decades I've used Neutrogena products) I'm continually being told how much younger I look by many, all the time, at least 20 years! (yes, it's amazing to me to hear that all the time from many), but it could be as simple as good genes from my mom......but I know this - every single time I've used Neutrogena products, I've never been disappointed in results they claim. I recently switched/was lured/curious to try another product (with a lot of hype, that was a little more expensive) - as I sometimes am when I see/hear/get curious about all the many claims of skin care products. Then I pour over tons of products that are confusing in a drugstore/online with many many claims - this does this, that does that - wishing there was ONE routine that actually does as it claims.. This happens often, and it's beyond frustrating and annoying to try them out and go off my normal routine for weeks to see if there is any result - for after time to give it a good trial, many times skin always looked WORSE, absolutely not better, with even more expensive products! Neutrogena has not disappointed - I return to my tried-and-true routine of serum and moisturizer, night and day - every time I return to Neutrogena. avis.titre: Works well but also purchase a face cream and sunscreen!
avis.texte: This is a great serum! I have noticed an improvement in my wrinkles and the overall smoothness and clarity of my skin. As with many anti-wrinkle products, there is a mild burning sensation when you first apply. This isn't anything too overwhelming and it didn't cause any actual irritation to my normally sensitive skin. After using it for several weeks, I no longer notice any burning. If you use this product, I would highly recommend also purchasing a good face cream. While this serum is effective at wrinkle treatment, it doesn't resolve any dryness to your skin. Also, please wear a sunscreen! I forgot to apply a good SPF and was outside for several hours and paid the price. Overall, this is a great product especially for the cost!

avis.titre: Works and doesn’t break the budget
avis.texte: Nuetrogena…I am faithful to for good reason. This pair of night time skin care products are my staple. I’m 60, live in Colorado where it is dry and hard on skin. I have seen so much improvement in wrinkles and overall freshness of the skin on my face from using this. There is no scent, the retinol aspect can be irritating if my face is chapped from mountain wind, but that is expected. I have ridiculously sensitive skin and this duo performs well with no reactions due to added perfume or stabilizers. I highly recommend this product for the budget conscious person who wants to get what she pay for!

I’m 86 yrs old and when I started using this product I was in my early seventies and already had a fair amount of wrinkles. I immediately saw a lessening of wrinkles along with Neutrogena Anti-Wrinkle daily moisturizer that they have, sadly, stopped making. Together they worked wonders and people who meet me for the first time all tell me that there is no way that I look my age. I just hope they don’t discontinue making this product.

avis.titre: Legit serum for anti-wrinkle and fading blemish scars, but comedogenic
avis.texte: I have mixed feelings with this serum. I have sensitive skin, yet I didn't experience tingling or redness, just some peeling and dryness which is typical for a retinol product. I believe through continuous use, this would ultimately fade most of my acne scars. The biggest concern for me is the inclusion of SODIUM CHLORIDE in the ingredient. That is SALT. Any comedogenic list would give this a red flag (as bright as possible). The webpage had the old ingredient list on, but actually the new one increases the dosage of sodium chloride and decreases the level of retinol. You can compare the order of ingredients in the old and new list to notice the change. I am writing to let those with acne-prone kin like me be aware that this serum may be helpful for fading your existing scars, but it may clog your pores to induce new ones. For those merely using this for anti-wrinkle purpose, this would be a legit serum.

I have really sensitive skin, like I can’t use anything, so I figured this would burn me but so far I’ve had no issues and after a week my skin already looks so much better! My complexion is clearer, my tone is more even, my pores are smaller, and my fine lines are definitely less noticeable. I’ve heard you absolutely have to be careful of the sun with retinol but I live in Florida and it’s summer, so I’m just using a basic spf 30 daily moisturizer on top and so far I’ve had no issues, though I will say I went to the beach yesterday and after 20 mins my face was on fire, so if you’ll be directly in the sun for a while maybe put on some real sunscreen. Other than that this product is surprisingly perfect.
